question_text: What may result from taking part in illegal road races?

options.text: The occurrence of serious road traffic accidents
The imposition of a term of imprisonment on the vehicle driver
The confiscation of the vehicle driver's driving licence

correct_answers.text: The occurrence of serious road traffic accidents
The imposition of a term of imprisonment on the vehicle driver
The confiscation of the vehicle driver's driving licence

comment: Participation in illegal road races can lead to serious traffic accidents and can result in a custodial sentence for the driver and the revocation of the driver's licence.
